why: The catalog states the Computer Science upper division rules as free text. The Design list and the 16-unit COMPSCI/ELENG/EECS rule are checkable, so they are written out here from that same text. Courses the text names that are no longer in the catalog (COMPSCI 182/W182, W186, EL ENG C128) are left to the self-check alternative.

rules.text: 4 design units from an approved special topics or graduate course, or from a listed course that has since been renumbered (COMPSCI 182/W182, W186, EL ENG C128)
16 upper division units reached by counting INFO 159, DATA 101 or STAT/DATA C100, the only courses outside COMPSCI/EL ENG/EECS that count
